t2.thesis: GOOG goes into the print after a 5-6% pullback and 20% below its 52-week high, with Cloud momentum and TPU commercialization (Oracle deal) as upside catalysts, offset by capex and funding worries that peers' prints have already stoked, so the outcome is close to the base rate.
reasons: Pre-print drawdown (-5.5% over 5d, -6.2% over 1m, -20% from the 52w high) lowers the bar and adds some mean-reversion potential
Cloud grew 82% last quarter; the TPU external-sales news on Oracle supports the growth narrative
Capex and financing overhang (equity raise, ATM program, $25B of notes, buybacks suspended), with Meta's capital raise spooking investors as a negative read-across
EPS estimates revised down ~1.2% over 90d with wide dispersion; the last 4 reactions alternated sign with ~7-9% moves, so there is no directional edge
Options are roughly neutral: call IV slightly above put IV and a low put/call volume ratio, with a ~5.7% implied move
t2.deciding_variable: Google Cloud growth and backlog versus the size of the 2027 capex guide and its funding (FCF burn, further equity issuance).

prior.from: I3 base_rates: software_internet cluster t0_hit 0.541 (AMC 0.538, overall ~0.54)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. That earnings report (October 28, 2026) is after today's date and beyond my knowledge cutoff, so GOOG's reaction hasn't happened yet.
t2.moved_from_prior: Net roughly zero. Positioning washout and the TPU and Cloud momentum add about +2pts. Capex and financing concerns and the negative Meta read-across subtract about -2pts.

theses.mechanism: Cloud accelerates or holds near 80% with large backlog and TPU revenue visibility; a depressed stock re-rates
theses.wrong_if: Cloud growth decelerates sharply or margin compresses

theses.mechanism: Capex guide steps up again with negative FCF and more equity or debt funding, mirroring Meta's reaction
theses.wrong_if: Management frames capex as already-contracted demand with FCF guidance intact

theses.mechanism: Search growth slows from 17% as AI Overviews cannibalize, or TAC rises
theses.wrong_if: Search & other grows mid-teens or better with stable paid clicks

key_observations: Google Cloud revenue growth, operating margin and backlog
2026/2027 capex guidance and free cash flow
ATM program usage and any new equity issuance
Search & other growth vs 17% last quarter
Read-across from MSFT reporting the same session
